title: Keyword Queue → Researched Article → Draft in CMS

sections.label: 1 · KEYWORD QUEUE
sections.note: Keywords are pulled from the content sheet in priority order, one per run. Anything already published is skipped so the same topic is never written twice.

sections.label: 2 · RESEARCH SERP
sections.note: The top-ranking pages for the keyword are fetched and read first. The brief is built from what is actually ranking, not from the model's memory of the topic.

sections.label: 3 · WRITE
sections.note: A full draft with headings, internal links and meta description, written against the brief. Length and structure follow what the SERP rewards for that specific query.

sections.label: 4 · DRAFT & FLAG
sections.note: The article is created as a CMS draft — never auto-published — and the row is marked so an editor can review, adjust and hit publish themselves.

output_sample.title: The Commercial HVAC Preventive Maintenance Checklist (Quarterly, Semi-Annual & Annual)
output_sample.meta_description: A season-by-season commercial HVAC maintenance checklist — what to inspect quarterly, semi-annually and annually, and which items actually prevent failures.
